title: celtis glabrata

The health benefits of Celtis glabrata include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Celtis glabrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
